project_derivatives.source: Project-original edits made with OpenAI's built-in image editing tool from the retained farm-setting plate; production requests retained in assets/source/generated/PROMPT.md
project_derivatives.transformation: The desktop plate preserves the established farm-setting camera, shelter, counter, landscape, and morning light while adding one physically supported right-side produce arrangement. The portrait plate is a deliberate same-set recomposition, not an automatic crop. Selected PNG masters were inspected at target aspect ratios and still-image AVIF-encoded with FFmpeg at CRF 24.

project_derivatives.source: Deterministic first-frame captures of the implemented timber shutter, rails, counter, lighting, contact shadow, and retained CC0 apple
project_derivatives.transformation: Captured from the revised local WebGL start state at 1536 by 1024 and 640 by 960 CSS pixels with HTML copy, navigation, controls, status, and basket suppressed; still-image AVIF-encoded with FFmpeg at CRF 24. The revised receiver uses the apple's calculated cast/contact shadow rather than the retired oval graphic. These are loading posters, not independent artwork or review baselines.
